mapper.select: select id, actor_uuid as actorUuid, type, entity_type as entityType, entity_id as entityId, is_read as isRead, read_at as readAt, created_at as createdAt from notification where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and type = #{type} and deleted_at is null order by created_at desc
mapper.update: update notification set is_read = 1, read_at = now(), updated_at = now() where receiver_uuid = #{currUserUuid} and type = #{type} and is_read = 0 and deleted_at is null
